cases.purpose: After 20 frames at 20 fps (the last frame is drawn about 0.95 s after the start, before the 1 s serve counter can be reached) the SERVING text is still drawn and the ball is still at the centre.
cases.oracle: Documented termpixel_pong rules: 80x80 pixel canvas drawn two pixels per terminal row, a 1 s serve delay during which the SERVING text (colour 220,220,80, 3x5 font at x=25,y=35) is drawn and the ball rests at the centre (40,40, 2x2), decoded by the pyte terminal model. Timing is real-clock (CLOCK_MONOTONIC): the frame loop is held to --fps 20, so N frames take at least (N-1)*50 ms; the cases use frame counts with at least 0.3 s of margin on each side of the 1 s delay.
cases.comparison: Final screen: cell (17,26) has background dcdc50 (SERVING text top row) and cell (20,41) is white (ball).

Timing is real-clock (CLOCK_MONOTONIC): the frame loop is held to --fps 20, so N frames take at least (N-1)*50 ms; the cases use frame counts with at least 0.3 s of margin on each side of the 1 s delay.
